Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7259); Rebecca (i.e. Ribkah), the wife of Isaac:--Rebecca.
BiblicalUsage: When Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac, the twins were not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand. Esau and Jacob struggled in her womb, and the elder served the younger, as God had told her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rebecca's twins are the proof that election is God's choice before ours, and the purpose stands whether we understand it or not.
